title: A numerical method for two-dimensional Boussinesq-Full Dispersion systems modelling internal wave propagation
summary: The paper is concerned with the numerical approximation of some two-dimensional asymptotic models for the propagation of internal waves in a two-layer system in the form of pde's for the interfacial deviation and the velocity. After the study of well-posedness of the periodic initial-value problem, the convergence of a semidiscrete approximation based on a spectral Fourier-Galerkin method is analyzed.
